name: How much does it cost per square foot to build a luxury home in the Los Angeles area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost per square foot to build a luxury home in the Los Angeles area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost per square foot for a luxury home in Los Angeles varies widely, typically ranging from $500 to over $1000, depending on several factors. These include the complexity of the design, the quality of materials and finishes chosen, site-specific challenges, and system integrations (e.g., smart home technology). It's important to consider that this range is a general estimate, and a detailed budget is developed after understanding your specific project requirements and design aspirations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury home construction costs in Los Angeles generally range from $500 to over $1000 per square foot, depending on design, materials, and site complexity.
